document: Decision 2020: Provincial politics in British Columbia, October 23, 2020 (Leger, 2020-10-23)
note: Final Leger poll before the 2020-10-24 election (wave 3). Mixed web (CAWI) and telephone (CATI), n=1,100; decided voters (incl. leaners and those who had already voted) weighted n=979, unweighted n=961. Shares among decided voters from the detailed results table (p. 9). n = unweighted regional bases. Leger splits the Lower Mainland into two disjoint columns, 'Lower Mainland' and 'Vancouver' (weighted 309 and 222 of 979, so 'Vancouver' is a sub-area of Metro Vancouver, not the whole CMA); new codes LOWER-MAINLAND-EXCL-VANCOUVER and VANCOUVER are used. 'Rest of BC' coded INTERIOR-NORTH. BCU = BC Liberal Party; AUTRES = 'Someone else'.
